# W Realty Miami (concept by Kerblabs)

> Concept site, not affiliated with the business. Facts from wrealtymiami.com.

W Realty Miami offers personalized real estate representation for buyers, sellers, renters and investors in Miami and South Florida. Wilma Perez is named on the site. Office phone: 305-321-4098.

## Services listed on their site
- Property search
- Homes for sale and for rent
- New developments
- Free home evaluation
- Mortgage calculator
- Dream Home Finder
- Blog and new-listing email alerts

## FAQ
- Who is the agent? Their site names Wilma Perez.
- Email and street address: not published on their live site (template fields are unfilled).

See services.json for the machine-readable list.
